mapper.insert: insert into dm_change_version (gmt_create, gmt_modified, owner_uid, ref_flow_id, ref_change_id, version, commit_id, content, type) select CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, owner_uid, #{flowId}, #{changeId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{commitId}, content, 'Change' from dm_change_item where owner_uid = #{ownerUid} and ref_change_id = #{changeId} and ref_change_item_type = 'REVIEW' order by content_index asc limit 1
